create.name: Ryan T. Schmidt
create.bio:
Ryan T. Schmidt is an interfaith hospice chaplain, ordained minister and spiritual care practitioner who lives in Bastrop, Central Texas. His roots are in the Christian contemplative tradition, and for more than two decades he has sat with people facing serious illness, death and loss in hospitals, hospices, schools, churches and volunteer programmes. He also works as a death doula and has led gospel singing and guided prayer for residents of memory care homes.

His approach rests on presence rather than fixing: listening closely, staying with what is true, and letting grief and meaning unfold at their own pace. He offers one-to-one support through bereavement and change, groups for people who are grieving or caring for someone, and teaching on dying and end-of-life care. He designs rituals and ceremonies for memorials, retreats and life thresholds, and trains others to hold ceremonial space. Through Illuman of Texas and Oklahoma he facilitates men's circles and retreats that explore council, archetype, time in nature and mature masculinity. With his wife, Aliceanne, he co-hosts the Remembering You podcast and runs free online circles for practising presence and connection. On Insight Timer he shares guided meditations, prayers and readings from sacred texts, including lectio divina.

courses.title: Grief & Transition Support
courses.description: Non-clinical spiritual care for people living through a death, an approaching loss or a major change, and for those caring for a loved one. Ryan offers individual support, grief and caregiver groups, and talks on dying and end-of-life care, using conversation, reflection and ritual.

courses.title: Ritual & Ceremony
courses.description: Help designing and leading memorials, remembrance gatherings, blessings, rites of passage and retreat openings and closings, plus training for chaplains, facilitators and circle leaders who want to learn how to hold ceremonial space with care.

courses.title: Men's Work with Ryan
courses.description: Retreats, council circles and teaching for men on presence, grief, archetype, initiation and mature masculinity, offered through Ryan's work with Illuman of Texas and Oklahoma, with ritual, silence, drumming and time outdoors.

free_resources.title: Ryan T. Schmidt on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Ryan's guided meditations and prayers in the Christian contemplative tradition, with quiet music and readings from sacred texts, free to hear in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Remembering You podcast and The Circle
free_resources.description: The podcast Ryan co-hosts with his wife, Aliceanne, on psychology, spirituality, grief, relationships and coming home to yourself, plus free online sessions for practising listening, naming emotions and honest connection.

The Resources page is not linked and no item names a condition; plan written under 'if unsure, write it and flag it'.
Only one usable photo (YouTube avatar); his site's images are scenery, an altar and a selfie with another person.

Availability set to local_online with Bastrop, Texas as base: his site gives Central Texas and in-person hospice, groups and men's retreats; online work is his Insight Timer content and free online circles. The queue had in_person false, so check.
Several of his YouTube videos are older One Desire Church material (Bible studies, guided prayer); kept the teaching ones, left out songs and family clips.
The 'Men's Work' retreats are run through Illuman of Texas and Oklahoma (official events registered on illumanoftexas.org).
